title: The Batkeepers’ Blue Hour
description: At twilight, the village bakers set their gingerbread garden by candlelight. The first bat takes a sip from a blue sugar flower.
alt: A bat hovers beside a blue-iced gingerbread flower above a candle while a baker and child watch from behind the counter.
pairing: A late-summer baking holiday × bats that sip from gingerbread flowers
